confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more stable; July accommodation rates are seasonal and the least certain. The FX observation was taken from rba.gov.au search results, not from a direct read of the RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of mainland Portuguese urban tourist pricing, placed slightly below Lisbon for dining and hotels, with a July high-season uplift on accommodation.
